skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Pale Rising Moon
skins.content: 0011 New Release / Pale Rising Moon. Inspired by the outfits Mr. Nothing uses to conceal others, with an improved design. Just as the moon waxes and wanes, some people occasionally decide to break character and act debonair.
skins.usage: One of Mr. Nothing's casual outfits.
skins.quote: He presses down his bamboo hat, the scenery of his hometown becoming a silhouette behind him.
